title: P0.70: Metacognitive Autonomy Roadmap Matrix
description: Roadmap matrix for IABV metacognitive autonomy: tracks each phase from birth to cross-device portability, with evidence references, missing links, next test, and risk if unfixed.
existing_services_consumed: concept_weight_evidence.py: existing CWE service — DiscernmentFrameService accepts its dict output, does NOT duplicate
TaskContextAssembler: already propagates CWE — only discernment_frame_summary added
PortableContext: already exports CWE — only roadmap_matrix and unresolved_links added
OSES._concept_weight_evidence_findings(): existing CWE findings — NOT duplicated

phases.description: System boots, creates first EnvironmentSelfModel and WorldModelSnapshot, records startup timeline.
phases.next_test: Verify birth frame has startup_timeline sensors and env_risks in live Windows runtime.

phases.description: Post-boot stabilization: freeze budget, deferred cognition under resource pressure.
phases.next_test: Confirm freeze budget blocks deep cognition under CRITICAL pressure.

phases.description: Live observation: WorldModel scans windows, network, tools; PerceptionSnapshot aggregates signals.
phases.next_test: WorldModel snapshot includes tool_live_status in Windows runtime.

phases.description: Grounding assessment: distinguish trusted vs untrusted sources, detect missing data.
missing_links: Live proof: concept_weight_evidence dict from existing service flows into DiscernmentFrame
phases.next_test: Build frame with concept_weight_evidence dict from existing service and verify concept_weights populated.
phases.risk_if_unfixed: medium — grounding works but concept weights may be empty without live data.

phases.description: Pre-action discernment: bias detection, contradiction analysis, attractor evaluation, confidence scoring.
missing_links: Live proof: discernment frame used in real task decision path
phases.next_test: End-to-end: user asks question -> TaskContextAssembler includes discernment_frame_summary in metadata.
phases.risk_if_unfixed: high — system may act without discernment.

phases.description: Introspective UI responses: answer 'me entiendes?', 'por donde vamos?', 'que falta?' from live evidence.
missing_links: Live proof: introspective question returns roadmap-based answer
phases.next_test: User types 'por donde vamos?' and gets phase-by-phase roadmap status.
phases.risk_if_unfixed: high — user gets generic local LLM answer instead of evidence-based response.

phases.description: Action execution with governance gates: AutonomyGovernancePolicy + AutonomousValidationCycle.
phases.next_test: Verify governance blocks action when grounding_status != grounded.

phases.description: Post-action learning: ExperimentLab records, StrategySelector updates, AdaptiveWeightLayer adjusts.
phases.next_test: After task completion, verify experiment run recorded and weight updated.

phases.description: Self-examination and adjustment: OSES detects patterns, recommends changes, validates if they worked.
missing_links: OSES discernment_frame_missing_in_task_context finding needs live proof
phases.next_test: Trigger OSES review with frames that have missing grounding; verify finding generated.
phases.risk_if_unfixed: medium — OSES may miss discernment-related anti-patterns.

phases.description: PortableContext exports complete metacognitive state for session transfer.
phases.next_test: Export portable context and verify roadmap_matrix section present.
phases.risk_if_unfixed: medium — new session won't know metacognitive progress.
